description: This file contains helper functions for the Coocook project, providing utilities for URL name generation and username validation, independent of any specific class or framework.

methods.name: url_name
methods.description: Replaces non-word characters in a string with hyphens, used for building URL-safe names.

methods.name: url_names_hashref
methods.description: Returns a hashref with URL-safe name variants, including a foldcased version.

methods.name: username_valid
methods.description: Checks if a username string contains only alphanumeric characters and underscores, indicating validity.
